rawContent:
Tweet by @MTSlive (MTS)
Author bio: Chronicling the singularity
Text: Lindy founder @Altimor reveals 19 out of 24 "AI 2027" predictions for 2026 have already come true and we are running ahead of the most optimistic predictions from 18 months ago:

"19 out of the 24 predictions they'd made for 2026, and we're only in August, have come true so far. It's a pretty silly track record."

"Look, we've all been in this game. I've been playing in AI since 2022. I have seen everybody's wildest predictions. We are currently ahead of the most optimistic predictions from literally like 18 months ago."

"I remember when I was saying in 2023, hey guys, a year and a half from now we're going to have a million token context window. And everybody was watching me like I was taking crazy pills, and now we have way more than that."

"This is why everybody keeps saying, we are not ready for this world, and it's coming very, very, very rapidly."
